{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean revenue and filter out QA and refunded orders
sales['revenue_clean'] = sales['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)
completed_only = sales[(sales['status'] == 'completed') & (sales['revenue_clean'] != 999999.99)]

# Verify the premise: 'converted' is 1 for completed checkout
print('Check: all completed orders have converted=1:', (completed_only['converted'] == 1).all())

# Check for any completed orders with converted=0
bad_orders = completed_only[completed_only['converted'] == 0]
print('\nCompleted orders with converted=0 (should be none):', bad_orders[['order_id', 'channel', 'customer_segment', 'converted']].to_dict('records'))"}
